top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes one transferable principle, small-molecule induced proximity between a chosen protein and an E3 ligase that turns occupancy-driven inhibition into catalytic, event-driven removal. It is validated by ternary-complex structures, kinetics and independent reproduction, and it has changed what chemists and clinicians can do. Crews and Deshaies conceived the heterobifunctional concept, and Handa's cereblon identification gives the glue lineage its molecular basis, so the trio stays within the three-laureate limit. Attribution (Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto) and the lack of an approved PROTAC are real costs, but the citation rests on the mechanism, which is mature.
